src/domain/errors/DomainError.ts: ValidationError, NotFoundError and ConflictError only build messages that describe domain failures. They carry no HTTP status codes or response formatting.

parsedVerdict.reasoning: This file only defines domain error types: an abstract DomainError base class plus ValidationError, NotFoundError and ConflictError. Each one describes a domain-level failure (a broken business rule, a missing entity, a state conflict) using plain TypeScript Error subclassing. Nothing in it maps errors to HTTP status codes, touches persistence, or depends on a framework. Turning these errors into transport responses is left to src/infrastructure/http/middleware/errorHandler.ts, so every responsibility here fits the domain layer.
